```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r Package Load}
# Install first time with commented line below or for updates
#detach("package:RoostEpiPkg", unload = TRUE)
remotes::install_github("HenryTraynor/RoostEpiPkg")
library(RoostEpiPkg)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(progress)

set.seed(123)
```

```{r Model Parameters}
# Epidemic parameters
epi_params <- create_epidemic_params(
  beta = 0.5,
  gamma = 0.03,
  model = "SIR"
)

# create spatial parameters and grid
spatial_params <- create_spatial_params(
  nx = 50,
  ny = 50
)

# Number of roosts
num_roosts <- 100

# Spatial clustering parameters
cluster_range <- c(1,round(num_roosts/4))
cluster_res <- 2
cluster_seq <- seq(
  cluster_range[1],
  cluster_range[2],
  by=cluster_res
)
sd_range <- c(0.03, 0.2)
sd_seq <- seq(sd_range[1], sd_range[2], length=length(cluster_seq))


# modern building proportion sequence
prop_modern_values <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
```

```{r Simulation Params}
# Min and max Clark Evan's R for our set of landscapes
R_breaks <- seq(0.2, 1.2, length.out = 10)

n_replicates <- 1
n_days <- 100
```

```{r Landscape set}
landscape_design <- generate_landscapes(
  n_per_bin = 10,
  R_breaks = R_breaks,
  prop_modern_values = prop_modern_values,
  num_roosts = 100,
  cluster_values = cluster_seq,
  sd_values = sd_seq,
  modern_N_max = 100,
  traditional_N_max = 20,
  min_N_max = 5,
  max_attempts = 10000
)

# Number of unique base landscapes
length(landscape_design$landscapes)

# Number of landscape-modernization combinations
nrow(landscape_design$design)

# Check that each R bin has 10 landscapes
table(vapply(
  landscape_design$landscapes,
  function(x) x$R_bin,
  integer(1)
))

# Check modernization balance
table(landscape_design$design$prop_modern)
```

```{r Test Sim}
# Select the first design combination
test_row <- landscape_design$design[1, ]
test_roosts <- test_row$roost_info[[1]]

# Initialize populations
test_roosts <- initialize_roost_populations(
  test_roosts
)

movement_params <- setup_movement(
  test_roosts,
  spatial_params
)

# Run the test
test_sim <- run_simulation(
  roost_info = test_roosts,
  spatial_params = spatial_params,
  movement_params = movement_params,
  epidemic_params = epi_params,
  n_days = 60
)

# Inspect the output
```

```{r Simulation}
total_runs <- nrow(landscape_design$design) * n_replicates

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  total = total_runs,
  format = "  Running [:bar] :percent | :current/:total | elapsed: :elapsed",
  clear = FALSE,
  width = 60
)

results <- vector("list", total_runs)
run_id <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(nrow(landscape_design$design))) {
  design_row <- landscape_design$design[i, ]

  for (rep in seq_len(n_replicates)) {
    run_id <- run_id + 1L
    pb$tick()

    # Get this landscape-modernization combination
    roost_info <- design_row$roost_info[[1]]

    # Initialize a fresh population for this replicate
    roost_info <- initialize_roost_populations(
      roost_info
    )

    # Rebuild movement parameters for this landscape
    movement_params <- setup_movement(
      roost_info,
      spatial_params
    )

    # Run the epidemic
    sim <- run_simulation(
      roost_info = roost_info,
      spatial_params = spatial_params,
      movement_params = movement_params,
      epidemic_params = epi_params,
      n_days = n_days
    )

    # Store the full simulation and its design metadata
    results[[run_id]] <- list(
      landscape_id = design_row$landscape_id,
      prop_modern = design_row$prop_modern,
      Clark_Evans_R = design_row$Clark_Evans_R,
      R_bin = design_row$R_bin,
      num_clusters = design_row$num_clusters,
      sd = design_row$sd,
      replicate = rep,
      simulation = sim
    )
  }
}

saveRDS(results, "roost_epidemic_simulations.rds")
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(min(3, nrow(landscape_design$design)))) {

  design_row <- landscape_design$design[i, ]

  for (rep in seq_len(1)) {

    message("Starting run: landscape row ", i, ", replicate ", rep)

    roost_info <- design_row$roost_info[[1]]

    message("Initializing population...")
    roost_info <- initialize_roost_populations(roost_info)

    message("Setting up movement...")
    movement_params <- setup_movement(
      roost_info,
      spatial_params
    )

    message("Running epidemic...")
    sim <- run_simulation(
      roost_info = roost_info,
      spatial_params = spatial_params,
      movement_params = movement_params,
      epidemic_params = epi_params,
      n_days = n_days
    )

    message("Simulation completed.")
  }
}
```
